# Database Schema

_Synchronised with `database/migrations` as of 2026-11-01. Update this file in the same change as any migration._

**Engine:** SQLite locally (`DB_CONNECTION=sqlite`), in-memory SQLite for tests.
**Key strategy:** application tables (`users`, `customers`, `products`, `sales`, `sale_lines`, `payments`, `payment_allocations`) use UUID primary keys generated by Eloquent `HasUuids` (ordered UUIDv7) — see [UUID_STRATEGY.md](UUID_STRATEGY.md). Framework infrastructure tables keep their defaults (string natural keys or auto-increment).
**Money:** integer pesewas in `*_pesewas` columns (ADR-0005, [FINANCIAL_LOGIC.md](FINANCIAL_LOGIC.md)).
**Business tables:** `customers`, `products`, `sales`, `sale_lines`, `payments`, `payment_allocations`, `counters`.

The `users`/`sessions` changes were made by editing the default migration `0001_01_01_000000` on 2026-11-01, before any shared environment existed. From now on, schema changes go in new migrations.

---

## Migration `2026_11_01_194210_create_customers_table`

### `customers`
Purpose: people the shop sells to. Model: `App\Models\Customer`. Never deleted (rule C5).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | no | | **PK**, `HasUuids` |
| name | varchar(255) | no | | **indexed** (list ordering/search) |
| phone | varchar(20) | no | | **unique**; always `+233XXXXXXXXX` (`PhoneNumber::normalise`) |
| email | varchar(255) | yes | null | lower-cased; not unique |
| address | varchar(255) | yes | null | free-text location |
| notes | text | yes | null | |
| is_active | boolean | no | `true` | |
| created_by | uuid | no | | **FK → `users.id`, `restrictOnDelete`** |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | null | |

## Migration `2026_11_01_194211_create_products_table`

### `products`
Purpose: items for sale and their current price. Model: `App\Models\Product`. Never deleted (rule P6).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | no | | **PK**, `HasUuids` |
| name | varchar(255) | no | | **indexed** |
| sku | varchar(64) | yes | null | **unique** (multiple NULLs allowed); stored upper-case |
| category | varchar(100) | yes | null | **indexed**; free text, first letter capitalised |
| price_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | | current selling price in pesewas, > 0 (enforced in app) |
| description | text | yes | null | |
| is_active | boolean | no | `true` | |
| created_by | uuid | no | | **FK → `users.id`, `restrictOnDelete`** |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | null | |

## Migration `2026_11_01_195455_add_image_and_stock_to_products_table`

Adds to `products`:

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| stock_quantity | int unsigned | no | `0` | units on hand; edited by admins (rule P7). Not yet changed by sales |
| image_path | varchar(255) | yes | null | path on the `public` disk, e.g. `products/abc123.jpg`; served via the `public/storage` link (rule P8) |

## Migration `2026_11_01_200957_create_sales_table`

### `sales`
Purpose: one completed sale. Model: `AppModelsSale`. Never edited or deleted (rule S11).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | no | | **PK** |
| receipt_number | varchar(20) | no | | **unique**; `R-000001` (rules R1–R2) |
| customer_id | uuid | yes | null | **FK → `customers.id`, restrict**; null = walk-in |
| sold_by | uuid | no | | **FK → `users.id`, restrict** |
| subtotal_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | | Σ line totals |
| discount_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | `0` | |
| discount_reason | varchar(255) | yes | null | only stored when a discount was given |
| total_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | | subtotal − discount |
| paid_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | `0` | Σ allocations; maintained by services |
| status | varchar(20) | no | | **indexed**; `paid`, `partly_paid`, `unpaid` (`SaleStatus`) |
| notes | text | yes | null | |
| idempotency_key | uuid | yes | null | **unique**; duplicate-submit protection |
| sold_at | timestamp | no | | **indexed**; allocation order |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | null | |

Composite index: (`customer_id`, `status`, `sold_at`) for balance and allocation queries.

## Migration `2026_11_01_200958_create_sale_lines_table`

### `sale_lines`
Purpose: products on a sale, with a price snapshot (rule S4). Model: `AppModelsSaleLine`.

| Column | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | no | **PK** |
| sale_id | uuid | no | **FK → `sales.id`, restrict** |
| product_id | uuid | no | **FK → `products.id`, restrict** |
| product_name | varchar(255) | no | copied at sale time |
| product_sku | varchar(64) | yes | copied at sale time |
| unit_price_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | copied at sale time |
| quantity | int unsigned | no | ≥ 1 |
| line_total_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | unit price × quantity |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | |

## Migration `2026_11_01_200959_create_payments_table`

### `payments`
Purpose: money received. Model: `AppModelsPayment`. Never edited or deleted.

| Column | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | no | **PK** |
| customer_id | uuid | yes | **FK → `customers.id`, restrict**; null for walk-in counter payments |
| received_by | uuid | no | **FK → `users.id`, restrict** |
| amount_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | > 0 |
| method | varchar(20) | no | `cash`, `mobile_money`, `bank_transfer`, `card` (`PaymentMethod`) |
| reference | varchar(100) | yes | e.g. MoMo transaction ID |
| notes | text | yes | |
| idempotency_key | uuid | yes | **unique** |
| received_at | timestamp | no | **indexed** |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | |

Composite index: (`customer_id`, `received_at`).

## Migration `2026_11_01_201000_create_payment_allocations_table`

### `payment_allocations`
Purpose: the part of a payment applied to one sale. Model: `AppModelsPaymentAllocation`.

| Column | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | no | **PK** |
| payment_id | uuid | no | **FK → `payments.id`, restrict** |
| sale_id | uuid | no | **FK → `sales.id`, restrict**; **indexed** |
| amount_pesewas | bigint unsigned | no | > 0 |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | |

Unique: (`payment_id`, `sale_id`). Invariant: Σ allocations per payment = `payments.amount_pesewas`; Σ allocations per sale = `sales.paid_pesewas`.

## Migration `2026_11_01_201001_create_counters_table`

### `counters`
Purpose: named sequences incremented under a row lock. Row `receipt` holds the last receipt number issued. No model; used by `ReceiptNumberService`.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| name | varchar(50) | no | | **PK** |
| value | bigint unsigned | no | `0` | last number issued |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | null | |

## Migration `0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table`

### `users`
Purpose: staff accounts that sign in to the application. Model: `App\Models\User`.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| id | uuid (`varchar` on SQLite, `char(36)` on MySQL) | no | | **PK**, generated by `HasUuids` |
| name | varchar(255) | no | | |
| email | varchar(255) | no | | **unique**; always stored lower-case (UserService/LoginService) |
| email_verified_at | timestamp | yes | null | cast `datetime`; not used by any feature yet |
| password | varchar(255) | no | | cast `hashed` (bcrypt) |
| role | varchar(20) | no | | **indexed**; `App\Enums\UserRole` value: `admin` or `cashier` |
| is_active | boolean | no | `true` | inactive users cannot sign in |
| last_login_at | timestamp | yes | null | set on each successful sign-in |
| remember_token | varchar(100) | yes | null | rotated on deactivation, password reset and admin password change |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamp | yes | null | |

### `password_reset_tokens`
Purpose: hashed self-service password-reset tokens (Laravel password broker, 60-minute expiry).

| Column | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| email | varchar(255) | no | **PK** |
| token | varchar(255) | no | |
| created_at | timestamp | yes | |

### `sessions`
Purpose: database session driver storage (`SESSION_DRIVER=database`).

| Column | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | varchar(255) | no | **PK** |
| user_id | uuid | yes | **indexed**; logical reference to `users.id`, *no FK constraint*. Rows are deleted by `UserService`/`PasswordResetService` to force sign-out |
| ip_address | varchar(45) | yes | |
| user_agent | text | yes | |
| payload | longtext | no | |
| last_activity | integer | no | **indexed** |
